items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: "Do you know one of another swinging little record boy we did with Lionel Hampton... 'Sweethearts on Parade,' by Lionel with Chu Berry playing the background."

ctx.x: Mildred Bailey, Red Norvo, Joe Marsella, oh yeah, Red Norvo, Lionel, Ella, of course Sarah, Sarah Vaughn, the Andrews Sisters, yeah, I did a lot of recordings.
How were those record dates arranged? Did they just tell you to show up at the studio at such and such a time?
